findings_qualitative.value: AGN-dominated nuclei tend to show elevated HCN-to-HCO+ J=3-2 flux ratios compared with starbursts, though some AGNs show non-high observed ratios

evidence.quote: we see a clear trend for AGNs, including infrared-elusive buried AGN candidates, to show elevated HCN-to-HCO$^{+}$ J=3–2 flux ratios, compared with starburst regions.

findings_qualitative.value: IRAS 15250+3609 shows a P Cygni-like HCO+ profile interpreted as outflow

evidence.quote: These features are interpreted to be due to the P Cygni profile by outflow activity of HCO$^{+}$.

claims.hypothesis: Elevated HCN/HCO+ flux ratios in AGNs also hold at J=3-2
claims.experiment: Compare ratios across Seyfert 1s, LIRGs and starburst regions
claims.result: AGNs show higher ratios than starbursts
claims.finding: Elevated ratio is a robust AGN signature, but not all AGNs selected

evidence.quote: The excess of the flux ratios in AGN-dominant nuclei in optical Seyferts and LIRGs with luminous obscured AGN signatures, compared with starbursts, is taken to be a robust result.

claims.hypothesis: Deeply buried AGNs show HCN v2=1f emission
claims.experiment: Moment 0 of tail on HCO+ J=3-2
claims.result: Detected at >4 sigma in IRAS 12112+0305 NE and IRAS 22491-1808
claims.finding: These may host extremely deeply buried AGNs, though compact starburst not excluded

evidence.quote: A luminous buried AGN is a plausible origin, although the possibility of a very compact extreme starburst cannot be completely ruled out

claims.hypothesis: Unobscured Seyfert 1 nuclei show HCN v2=1f emission
claims.experiment: Search in NGC 7469 and I Zw 1
claims.finding: Consistent with lower line opacity in unobscured AGNs; no evidence of different pumping efficiency

evidence.quote: Currently, we do not see any evidence that the infrared radiative pumping efficiency is different between these two types of AGNs.

why_this_data.value: Band 6 allows simultaneous coverage of HCN/HCO+ J=3-2 and v2=1f lines at z up to ~0.3 with better atmospheric conditions than band 7

evidence.quote: HCN/HCO$^{+}$ J=3–2 observations in band 6 are less affected by the Earth’s atmospheric background noise

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: IC 4329 A non-detection: synchrotron-dominated L-band, extended IR, sub-thermal excitation and broad lines considered unlikely

evidence.quote: Thus, this possibility also seems unlikely.

limitations_admitted.value: Superantennae continuum determination ambiguity larger; HCN v2=1f detection may be contaminated by HCO+ v=0

evidence.quote: although a possible contribution from the bright HCO$^{+}$ v=0 J=3–2 emission line cannot completely be ruled out

referee_caveats_inferred: Detections of HCN v2=1f are only ~4 sigma and blended with HCO+
Sample is small and heterogeneously classified
Line opacity not corrected for most sources
Ratio comparison uses non-matched beams/physical scales

data_public_as_stated.value: Project codes given; public status not explicitly stated
